How usage is calculated

## You pay per block run.Priced by complexity.

Each step in a workflow is a block. Simple blocks cost less. Complex AI blocks cost more. Total cost = number of runs × block price.

Simple operations

$0.02 / run

Formatting, routing, export

Standard AI

$0.10 / run

$0.30 / run

Data extraction, generative AI

A typical invoice processing workflow runs 4–6 blocks per document. Volume discounts apply on Credits Accelerate and Enterprise plans.

FAQ

## Common questions.

What are credits?

Credits are prepaid usage you can spend across any workflow blocks. Volume purchases unlock discounts of up to 40%. Credits are shared across your team and never expire.

What is a block?

A block is a single step in a workflow — extracting data, classifying a document, formatting a field, or posting to an integration. Each time a block runs, it counts as one run.

How do I estimate my cost?

Total cost = number of runs × block price. A typical invoice processing workflow runs 4–6 blocks per document. At $0.30 per complex AI block, that's under $2 per invoice end-to-end.

Can I switch plans?

Yes. You can upgrade to Growth or Enterprise at any time. If you're an existing Nanonets customer on legacy pricing, reach out to your account manager.

Is there a free trial?

Yes, every account starts with $50 in free credits, no card required, so you can process documents before you spend a dollar. When you're ready, $100/month gets you 100 credits.
